Classes module

Classes module for the School Management System

This module defines the core data models: Person, Student, Instructor, and Courses. It enforces validation rules (age, email format) and provides helper methods for course registration and instructor assignment.

Author: Hilda Awada & Mary Fadlallah Version: 1.0 License: MIT
